text_block_list.text:
Фудзи Кисэки astounds and enraptures the
audience
at the Yasuda Kinen, and her
fans' expectations
for her continue to
swell. Yet, I can't help but feel
that
something was off about her
performance.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
My unease grows stronger, and I rush to
find her.
Unfortunately, a worried Hishi
Amazon informs
me that Фудзи Кисэки has
left without me.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Our next race is the autumn Tenno Sho.
But first, I
need to find out what's wrong
with Фудзи Кисэки.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
